title: skbrain instance config v1
description: The skbrain.yaml at the root of an estate canon repo (skbrain-ops-<estate>). Unknown fields fail. src/skbrain/config.py is the normative validator and must agree with this file (tests/test_config.py checks they do).

estate.description: Short lowercase estate name. The repo must be named skbrain-ops-<estate>.

namespace.description: The projection namespace (the Postgres schema). Always ops in v1.

framework.description: The pinned framework release tag. Must equal the framework/ submodule tag and the installed package version.

forge.description: Host (optionally host:port) of the forge that holds this canon. No scheme, no path.

projector_nodes.description: Short hostnames allowed to run skbrain sync --commit for this canon.

instance.description: The one skrsi instance (owner/name) allowed to open lesson PRs here and whose evidence refs pages may cite.

writers.description: Identities allowed to author PRs. CI warns on any other author.

reviewers.description: Identities allowed to review and merge. Should not overlap writers.

nodes.description: Optional. The node page slugs this estate may name. When present, a page naming a node-<x> slug outside this list is flagged (warning in v1).
